answer: Public Marble Draw: each agent submits a whisper, a one-time nonce, against a hash seed revealed only after the commitment window, so no attacker can precompute the winning value. A failed whisper voids the relic record, and each fake identity the attacker mints pays a fixed gas penalty per failed round. The relic, once valid, locks the agent into one ledger slot for that epoch, capping throughput to a single verified randomness round.
